address: chaussée de la Seigneurie 13, Petit-Rechain, 4800, Belgium
bio: Sophie’s grandparents were hatmakers (hence the name), but Sophie’s love was cooking. In a tastefully refurbished brick townhouse, she turns out comfortingly familiar dishes, oozing with elegance. Spot-on cooking, a sprinkling of creativity and punchy, powerful sauces are combined in well-balanced dishes....
